timing_note: Resumable execution: completed database phases and matching graph caches are reused. These timings are not a cold-start whole-pipeline benchmark.

routes.scope: same bounded driving-distance workload; excludes graph construction and import

repository_arithmetic.checks: Original unmodified arixel worker, mocked neighbor retrieval, same graph distances, full 24-hour axis before output mask.

year.note: Sum of sampled cell densities is a comparison statistic, not a probability or an integrated network mass.

hour.note: Sum of sampled cell densities is a comparison statistic, not a probability or an integrated network mass.

stage_definitions.baseline: Repository arithmetic, bounding-box assignment, original sparse output mask; reconstructed common graph.
stage_definitions.formula: Only the spatial argument is fixed; assignment, source-time handling, and output mask stay as baseline.
stage_definitions.corrected: Spatial argument, source-lixel temporal smoothing and explicit complete time axes fixed; exact nearest-edge assignment with explicit 100 m quality threshold; original Epanechnikov kernel retained. Complete density field retained separately from the intentional event-bearing-only display policy.
stage_definitions.paper: All correctness fixes plus true quartic/biweight kernels to match the paper prose; a separate modeling change.

limitations: No original 2017 shapefiles, QGIS project, camera, or classification breaks were supplied.
Current historical records and current NYS roads are used.
The paper end date is approximated as April 30, 2017.
Current Manhattan roads contain many more separate features than the approximately 900 reported in the paper.
Common graph uses deterministic planar noding on a 1 m precision grid, not the original order-sensitive topology insertion and 5 m splitting tolerance.
Planar connectivity does not model grade-separated crossings, as in the original pipeline.
Original bounding-box ties were unspecified; this baseline resolves ties by lixel ID.
The paper did not specify planar KDE bandwidth or color-class breaks; their reconstruction is separately documented.
Partial 2012 and 2017 coverage means raw annual values are not exposure-adjusted crash rates.
